title: superclaude no longer masks exit 3 for the ground loop, and its comments say the loser exits quietly
intention: superclaude's ground-loop unit is started without -p SuccessExitStatus=3, and superclaude's comments and log lines say the singleton loser exits 0 quietly, so a loser that regresses to the loud exit 3 reads as a failed unit again; the cc charter says the same.
why: Orchestrator, 2026-11-13: after b38af5fd1852 (35711160e, Akien's Q#93 answer, outline 5.3.5.2.1) the ground loop's loser exits 0, so superclaude's -p SuccessExitStatus=3 (line 636) and its comments 'the singleton loser exits 3' (lines 5, 524, 553-557, 672, 689) are stale, and the flag makes a loud exit 3 read as success. The cc charter repeats the story in three fields.
traces_to: Law 5 (the thing and the story of the thing may never contradict) and Law 7 (a regression to a loud exit must not be hidden).
how: Delete `-p SuccessExitStatus=3 \` from _sc_loop_start; rewrite the stale comments and the two log lines to say a loser exits 0 quietly (keep the 2026-08-18 history, marked removed); correct the three charter fields through the artifact door. One proof reads the launcher's text on any OS.

clauses.claim: the launcher's ground-loop unit start (_sc_loop_start) no longer passes -p SuccessExitStatus=3, where it did
superclaude no longer says the ground loop's singleton loser exits 3, in its comments or its log lines, where it said so in five places

decisions.text: D1: remove the flag and rewrite the stale comments and log lines in superclaude.
D2: correct the cc charter's three fields that state the flag and 'exits 3 BY DESIGN', through the artifact door.
D3: one proof reading the launcher's text, one tooth per clause; red first, and red on a hollow build.

out: cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py (its arm 3 comment is stale but its commands measure systemd, not the launcher)

measured.saw: superclaude passes -p SuccessExitStatus=3 at _sc_loop_start (line 636) and says the loser exits 3 at lines 5, 524, 553-557, 595-596, 672 and 689; the cc charter repeats it in superclaude/ground_loop_spawn (shape, why_SuccessExitStatus_3_is_not_optional, why_reset_failed_moved_to_the_retry). Inside a tester run the launcher also adds -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed.
measured.how: grep -n 'SuccessExitStatus|exits 3|exit 3' cairn/devices/cc/superclaude; read the charter fields with json
